name: dramatic
label: Dramatic
css: .style-dramatic { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-surface, #09090B) 0%, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.08) 100%); position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 48px; min-height: 1080px; width: 1080px; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--slide-text, #FAFAFA); } .style-dramatic::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -40%; right: -20%; width: 600px; height: 600px; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #8B5CF6) 0%, transparent 70%); border-radius: 50%; opacity: 0.12; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; } .style-dramatic::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -30%; left: -15%; width: 500px; height: 500px; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #8B5CF6) 0%, transparent 70%); border-radius: 50%; opacity: 0.08; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; } .style-dramatic > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; } .style-dramatic .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 0; color: var(--slide-text, #FAFAFA); text-transform: uppercase; max-width: 90%; text-shadow: 0 4px 32px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.2); } .style-dramatic .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; margin: 24px 0 0 0; color: var(--slide-text, #FAFAFA); max-width: 85%; opacity: 0.95; } .style-dramatic .step { position: absolute; top: 48px; right: 48px; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: var(--slide-primary, #8B5CF6); opacity: 0.15; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.04em; } .style-dramatic .brand { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--slide-primary, #8B5CF6); text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0; } .slide-code.style-dramatic { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(9, 9, 11, 0.95) 0%, rgba(9, 9, 11, 0.98) 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.2); } .slide-code.style-dramatic::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #8B5CF6) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.06; } .slide-code.style-dramatic .hook { color: var(--slide-text, #FAFAFA); text-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.25); } .slide-code.style-dramatic .text { color: rgba(250, 250, 250, 0.9); } .slide-insight.style-dramatic { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(9, 9, 11, 0.98) 0%, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.12) 100%); border-left: 4px solid var(--slide-primary, #8B5CF6); } .slide-insight.style-dramatic::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #8B5CF6) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.1; } .slide-insight.style-dramatic .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #8B5CF6); text-shadow: 0 4px 32px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.3); } .slide-insight.style-dramatic .insight-text { font-size: 48px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--slide-text, #FAFAFA); padding: 24px 0; max-width: 90%; }
